in_marathi.name: Ansraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ansraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ansraj is derived from Sanskrit, where An means 'Lord' and Sraj means 'Treasury'. This name signifies the one who is the guardian of wealth, both material and spiritual. In Hindu mythology, Ansraj is the name of a deity who is believed to be the treasurer of the gods.
